[SWS_DM_00946] Occurrence Counter increment strategy ’testFailed’-only
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04067
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DiagnosticCommonProps.occurrenceCounter-
Processing
is set to
testFailedBit
and a certain
event
is already stored in
the
event memory
, for each transition of
UDS DTC status bit
"
kTestFailed
"
from ’0’ to ’1’, the DM module shall trigger the increment of the associated occurrence
counter by one, regardless of
UDS DTC status bit
"
kConfirmedDTC
" state.
⌋
